Trump Halts Iran Attack After Gulf Allies' Appeal, Cites Diplomacy

U.S. President Donald Trump announced that the U.S. had prepared a significant attack against Iran but called it off following appeals from Gulf allies. Trump stated that diplomacy was given more time, though Iran denied requesting the U.S. to halt strikes. The decision came after reports of negotiations between Iran and Oman and amid a backdrop of oil price fluctuations. Trump also indicated that Gulf leaders' input heavily influenced the decision to hold off on new Iran strikes.
